senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. כָּלָה)to consume, burn; to roast, parch. Sifra Vayikra, N’dab., ch. XIV, Par. 13 אפשר יִקְלֶנּוּ גרש the text might have meant that one must parch it as grit; יקלנו אביב one must parch it in the ear.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 75a:14">Pes. 75ᵃ</cite> <he>ונִקְלֶהָ</he>, v. next w.—Part. pass. <he>קָלוּי</he>. Sifra l. c., v. <cite ref="S01320"><he>קָלִי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Menachot 66b:2">Men. 66ᵇ</cite> <he>אם אביב ק׳ אם גרש ק׳</he> whether parched in the ear or as grit; a. e.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:11:1">Cant. R. to III, 11</cite> <he>מִתְקַלְהָא</he>, v. <cite ref="S00201"><he>קָהָה</he></cite>.
